_how_to: Statements that must never appear in anything you send. The checks block a resume, letter or answer that matches a rule.

Start empty. Add a rule each time you catch a mistake in a draft, so the same mistake cannot return. Typical sources: a metric whose denominator you could not verify, a certification you do not hold, a claim of users or deployment you cannot back up, an employer or course name that is meaningless outside your school.
Fields: id (short name), pattern (regex, case-insensitive), message (what is wrong and what to say instead), unless (optional regex; if it also matches, the rule does not fire).

{"id": "modeled-vs-realized", "pattern": "(?:increased|reduced|saved) (?:\\w+ ){0,5}40\\s*%", "unless": "model(?:ed|led)|estimate", "message": "The 40% figure is a modeled estimate, not a realized result; say 'modeled'."}
